title: Fall Creek Farm and Nursery invests in mechanical harvesting company
summary: Report by Christina Herrick that Fall Creek took a minority investment in the mechanical harvesting business FineField.
why_it_matters: A genetics company investing in harvest machinery signals that machine-harvest suitability is being treated as a breeding objective rather than an afterthought. This connects directly to the machine-harvest trait claims later made for 'FC11-164'.

reading.rationale: Directly informs how to read the company's later machine-harvest variety claims.

testing.rationale: Machine-harvest performance is testable and should be on the trial list.

commercial_position.rationale: Vertical integration into harvest technology is a durable competitive move.

monitoring.rationale: Track whether the investment converts into commercial deployments.
